nodes.label: Adopt Connections With accept(), Never available()
nodes.rationale: accept() hands over a connection exactly once, transferring ownership. available() returns whichever client has unread data and returns that same client again on every call, so an accept loop built on it adopts one connection into several slots and splits one HTTP request across several sockets.

nodes.label: Detect Disconnects Before Accepting
nodes.rationale: Order inside Poll() matters: disconnect detection, then accept, then pump. If accept runs first a just-dropped slot can be handed to a new connection before net_close is sent, and the Linux side feeds new bytes into the old socket.

nodes.label: Edge-Triggered was_up Disconnect Tracking
nodes.rationale: Act on the was-connected to not-connected transition. Testing !connected() every pass emits net_close continuously for slots that are merely idle.

nodes.label: loop() Must Yield
nodes.rationale: Poll() returns immediately when idle so loop() spins at full speed, starving the Bridge RPC thread until servo_read misses its 10s deadline. A delay(1) at the end of Tick() costs nothing against the latency budget.

nodes.label: One Bulk Read Per Slot Per Pass
nodes.rationale: Use client.read(buffer, sizeof(buffer)), not a byte-at-a-time loop, and never block or delay() inside the pump because the same loop() also drives the servo bus.

nodes.label: kRelayChunkBytes Must Match relay_chunk_bytes
nodes.rationale: One number in two places, bytes per Bridge message. Halving it doubles the number of Bridge round trips for identical payload; 256 is the value the working relay used.

nodes.label: Bridge Net Contract
nodes.rationale: MCU to Linux: net_open(slot, client_ip), net_rx(slot, data), net_close(slot). Linux to MCU: net_tx(slot, data), net_shutdown(slot).

nodes.label: provide_safe Registration
nodes.rationale: net_tx and net_shutdown are called from the Bridge thread while loop() may be inside the relay, so they must be registered with provide_safe. Payloads are MsgPack bin_t and must not be packed into a String.

nodes.label: Serial Works; Monitor Is Optional
nodes.rationale: The sketch prints through Serial and that is proven. Monitor (the Bridge console facade) only adds reach to App Lab over WiFi; there is no correctness reason to switch.

nodes.label: Rewriting Instead Of Porting Reintroduced Solved Bugs
nodes.rationale: The relay was once rewritten from scratch instead of ported, and the rewrite reintroduced problems the original had already solved. The reference is the Stage-2 relay sketch.
